k_definition: k is the number of injected flips. At that cutoff precision@k equals recall@k. precision_at_10pct and recall_at_10pct use k = 10% of rows.

review_budget.definition: A predeclared human review budget. Precision and recall are measured only among the top-ranked rows within this budget; the Wilson interval describes uncertainty in that reviewed sample.
review_budget.decision_boundary: Synthetic ranking evidence only; no row is relabeled or dropped automatically.
